author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex
statement: A deterministic expander-walk candidate multiset has q d^(P-1) 2^P rows per round, q < 2m and d=O(log(m+2)); it rejects each support of size at least m/P with probability at least 1/20, enabling 14n greedy rounds under the source counting oracle. This compresses preprocessing but does not improve the selected SAT bound.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size construction and oracle cost composition
Find and charge an explicit small-bias coefficient family if reducing the 2^P factor
No improved alpha or full new SAT algorithm is claimed
